title: Fixed-Capacity Ring Buffer for IMU Samples
hints: Store `std::array<T, N> buf_`, a `head_` index (next write slot), and a `size_`.
push: `buf_[head_] = v; head_ = (head_ + 1) % N; if (size_ < N) ++size_;`
The oldest element lives at `(head_ + N - size_) % N`, so `operator[](i)` is `buf_[(head_ + N - size_ + i) % N]`.
Out-of-range access: throw `std::out_of_range` (check `i >= size_` first). `back()` is `(*this)[size_ - 1]` after an empty check.
